records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Bright Systems set up
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Bright Systems* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 1 and an invite sent (facts), so momentum exists, but no key milestone in 6 days and a trust-damaging data mismatch ticket (tick_e38ef79720fa) just closed [email:571045e0]. Two unanswered nudges [email:ffb1b37f, email:2fa3bc43] suggest low engagement; 8 days left.

draft.subject: Following up on the dashboard/export fix
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks for flagging the dashboard and export mismatch last week -- Tariq let you know it should be resolved, so please do say if the numbers still look off on your side, especially since you're reporting them upward.

I also saw one invite has gone out. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting your team's real work in there is usually what makes the numbers worth reporting.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through your next step with you.

Best,
Nadia
